title: Understanding Overfitting
text: Overfitting occurs when a model learns the training data too well, including its noise and outliers, which can lead to poor performance on new data. Think about how reducing complexity might help.

title: Reducing Model Complexity
text: One way to reduce overfitting is by simplifying the model. Consider how removing some features might affect the model's ability to generalize.
